html.rights-3: Request deletion (except where the law requires the information to be retained)
html.rev-inquiry: Added — From October 11, 2026, Section 1(f), “Consultation request form” and the retention period for “Consultation requests” in Section 2 apply. This tells you what we collect now that the site has a consultation request form.
html.rev-hanpan-trend: Added — From November 10, 2026, Section 1(g), “Trend news on the Hanpan Home screen” applies. It describes the request that Hanpan, our document program, sends to trend.tenai.kr to show the trend forecast on its Home screen. Also changing: the retention periods in Section 2 · the processors in Section 4.
html.hanpan-trend-1: To show today's trend forecast on the trend card of its Home screen, the Company's document program Hanpan fetches the forecast from trend.tenai.kr about 3 seconds after it starts and every 6 hours after that. Only the following reaches the Company's server.
html.hanpan-trend-2: No account information, no number that tells devices apart, and no document or file information is sent, and no cookies are used. The Company does not store or count these requests. As in Section 1(d), the IP address may be recorded automatically in the server logs of our infrastructure providers. The forecast received is kept only on the user's PC. Removing the trend card in Hanpan's “Customize Home” stops these requests.
html.hanpan-trend-3: If you click the trend card and open the trend.tenai.kr site in a browser, the site records an aggregate count of visits that cannot identify individuals (page viewed, where the visit came from, device type) with Vercel Web Analytics, without cookies.
html.rev-hanpan-key: Upcoming change — From November 20, 2026, Section 1(h), “Hanpan security key” and Section 1(i), “Receiving advertising information (optional)” apply. They concern only members who get a Hanpan security key or consent to advertising information. Also changing: the note in Section 1(d) · retention periods in Section 2 · processors and overseas transfer in Section 4 · user rights in Section 5. (Announced November 13, 2026)
html.hanpan-key-1: When you get a security key to use Hanpan for Windows, the Company processes the information below. It is needed to issue and verify keys under the Hanpan Terms you agreed to, so it is processed to perform that contract without separate consent (Personal Information Protection Act, Article 15(1)(iv)). If you do not get a key, none of it is processed.
html.hanpan-key-2: The device-number hash is the unique number of your PC or USB drive turned into a value that cannot be reversed; the original number is never received. Because it is stored with your member number, it is treated as personal information. Hanpan does not send your documents or your conversations with AI to tenai.kr.
html.marketing-1: Only members who give each of the two consents below have their information processed, on the basis of that consent. Without consent you can still sign up, download Hanpan and get security keys.
html.marketing-2: Advertising emails go only to members who give both consents. You can withdraw at any time under “My info” on the member page, or with the unsubscribe link at the bottom of an email (no login needed).
html.rights-6: Withdraw consent to advertising information: under “My info” on the member page, or with the unsubscribe link in an email without logging in; the result is shown on screen right away (from November 20, 2026)
html.rights-7: Revoke a Hanpan security key: at any time on the member page; the device-number hash is deleted right away (from November 20, 2026)
